verdict.rationale: Gecko lets users create named API keys (e.g. 'CI/CD Pipeline'), and keys are visible team-wide with owner attribution and per-request usage logging, so an agent can be given its own attributable credential. Nothing shows those keys can be limited by permission, resource, or read/write access, which is the core of the least-privilege story. The scoped, auto-rotating GitHub App access covers Gecko's own access to GitHub, not credentials issued to an agent. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes, resource/repo-level restriction, read-only vs write key types, key expiry controls, independent corroboration.
